POTS phenotyping · ontology rebuild · 2 October 2026

How four readers voted on every link

Four readers looked for links between the 72 vocabulary terms in seven seed papers. A link went into the ontology only when two different kinds of reader found it in the same paper. This page shows where they agreed, where they did not, and what came out.

Claude: 2 of 3 readings AND Jevor winnowor laya →In the ontology

The readers

ReaderWhat it readsWhat it returnsPapersSame answer twice?
ClaudeThe whole paper, tables included, three timesLinks with a word-for-word quoteAll 7No (86% of links match)
JevOne paragraph at a time; hosted by TypeSafeLinks with the paragraph and a probability4 open-licence papersNo (93–96% match)
winnowOne paragraph at a time; runs on this MacSame as JevAll 7Yes, byte for byte
layaOne paragraph at a time; runs on this MacSame as JevAll 7Yes, byte for byte

Jev, winnow and laya are System One models: they answer four typed questions per paragraph (which terms, is there a relationship, which relation, which terms) and never write text. None of the three sees tables or figure text.
